name: An Essay in Aid of a Grammar of Assent
name_pt: Ensaio em Auxílio de uma Gramática do Assentimento
desc: Newman's philosophical work of 1870 on how the mind comes to believe. Part I distinguishes notional from real assent, and apprehension from inference. Part II studies assent and certitude, and in the Illative Sense gives the faculty by which we judge concrete matters; the last chapters apply it to the evidences of natural and revealed religion.
desc_pt: A obra filosófica de Newman (1870) sobre como a mente chega a crer. A primeira parte distingue o assentimento nocional do real e a apreensão da inferência. A segunda estuda o assentimento e a certeza e, no Sentido Ilativo, descreve a faculdade pela qual julgamos as questões concretas; os últimos capítulos a aplicam às provas da religião natural e da revelada.
editor: John Henry Newman (Longmans text; Newman Reader)
edition: An Essay in Aid of a Grammar of Assent (London: Longmans, Green, 1870 and later impressions), as transcribed by the Newman Reader.
note: Chapters 4, 5, 6, 8 and 10 each join the Newman Reader's pages for their sections. The two Dublin Review notices of the book (by others) are left out.
